title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
statement: Given a string, return the length of the longest substring that contains no repeated characters.

editor_note.idea: Maintain a sliding window with unique characters and move the left boundary when a duplicate appears inside the window.
editor_note.data_structure_reason: A hash map remembers the latest index of each character so the left pointer can jump directly.
editor_note.edge_cases: The left pointer only moves forward.
editor_note.pitfalls: Updating left with an older index can incorrectly shrink the window backwards.
